During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] '''attacked''' the [[Sadic's laboratory|laboratory]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sadic]] deep in the Imperial prison district of [[Shadow Town]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. With the help of [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Knight defeated Sadic, who had willingly undergone the [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard]] process in order to gain new power, and the commandos of the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces's]] [[Blackstar Squad]] destroyed the laboratory after the battle on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] instructions so that the Power Guard Project would die with Sadic.
